Class AppTester<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.testing.AppTester<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the application class
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class AppTester<T> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Runs an application in a test: the real lifecycle, headless, with fakes for the platform, the directories, the clock and the dialogs. 
try (AppTester<CounterApp> app = AppTester.start(CounterApp.class, Locale.FRENCH)) {
    app.commands(CounterAppCommands.class).increment().execute();

    assertThat(app.component(JLabel.class).getText()).isEqualTo("Le compte est : 1.");
}

Frames and dialogs are never realized: each window is a bare root pane, where the content, menu bar and toolbar are built and laid out. Every call on the tester, and on the commands it returns, runs on the EDT and waits; before returning, the tester runs the updates posted by observables and waits for the tasks commands start, so assertions see the components as the user will. A component repainted or invalidated off the EDT, a failure no handler handles, and duplicate mnemonics or shortcuts, in a dialog or in a menu the framework rebuilt after a dynamic section changed, fail the test at the tester's next call.

The platform is gaia's FakePlatform for Linux, with its directories on a gaia-memfs file system, so window state is saved in memory. Time is a FakeTicker and an InstantSource fixed at the epoch.
